items.q: Anyhow, he brought this guy around to the room.

ctx.x: Anyhow, he brought this guy around to the room. And they had one of those Auburn(?) books. It's a big thing. It's a book that you learn in, but it's got all the...all of the trombone things, all the exercises and things that a trombone does.
